title: Signature Capability Gap Inventory
body:
Overview

This record belongs to the Universal Capability Gap and Upgrade Planner Signature Database (Signature edition), Manon's original counterpart to the public database of the same name. The Signature edition does not copy any public product: it restates the subject in Manon's own Signature framing, as a design that lives inside the Signature ecosystem. Capability Gap Inventory covers the following in Signature terms: lists every measured weakness found by the benchmark suite, with its task class and evidence. The record is written as a complete, usable file, with a demo program genuinely executed at build time and its output stored beside the code. Benchmark honesty: this database defines part of the fixed test suite for the R32 capability collection. Its target is 99% measured reliability on defined tasks (TARGET, not measured result). The comparative measurement run comes after building and is not claimed anywhere in this round. As master coordinator for the R32 collection, this pair tracks gap analyses and upgrade recommendations, and promotes only changes that pass the test gate.

How the Signature design works

The Signature design works like this: the planner inventories measured weaknesses from the benchmark suite, scores each gap by impact, locates the database or generator that could address it, and recommends upgrades in impact order, promoting only changes that pass the test gate. Applied to this record, the design means the following in practice: lists every measured weakness found by the benchmark suite, with its task class and evidence. The record sits at ladder rank simple in the teaching ladder, which runs simple, then compounded, then most complex, so a Signature reader can start from the simpler records and work toward this one.

The demo scores capability gaps by impact and prints the highest-impact gap and its recommendation. The demo program prints:
